title: Identity derived transport for section-normalized relabelling
statement: For a section-normalized identity relabelling A and an ambient identity comparison c, the induced derived identity transport equals the canonical transport of the ordinary identity coherence k, and the corresponding transported Hom equation holds componentwise.

source.place: Step 6 identity specialization; transport of the canonical identity Hom square through the section-normalized relabelling.

proof.text: Use the completed-projection uniqueness argument of reindex_eq to identify the coefficient isomorphisms before deriving. The induced equality isomorphism of ordinary module functors, followed by A.identity, is k.ordinary: after equality induction on the coefficient isomorphisms, both maps have the recorded restriction formula; the hom and inverse site-identity components are the same identity on underlying schemes. The degree formula identifies k.complex with the termwise image of k.ordinary. The model formula and localization extensionality identify k.derived with the derived image of k.ordinary followed by the derived identity isomorphism. Derived natural-isomorphism functoriality now gives the first equality. Expand homComparison, combine the two Hom-functor maps, and cancel the transported inverse pairs in the opposite/product category to get the second equality.

source.place: Step 6: section-normalized identity and successive reindexing.

proof_origin.place: R2: sectionwise normalization, localization uniqueness, and categorical transport of the ambient Hom identity/composition equations.

theorem identity_transport_data (A : PodReindexFamily l E) (hA : A.Relabelling l E)
    (W : Scheme.{u}) [∀ w : W, Invertible (l : W.residueField w)]
    (c : Comparison l E (𝟙 W))
    (k : PodReindexingCoherence.Identity l E W none)
    (M N : D l E W) :
    A.identityDerived l E W = (reindexIso l E (𝟙 W)).symm ≪≫ k.derived ∧
    (homComparison l E (𝟙 W) c M N).hom ≫
        (podReindexingDerivedHom l E W none).map
          (Prod.mkHom ((A.identityDerived l E W).inv.app M).op
            ((A.identityDerived l E W).hom.app N)) =
      (reindexIso l E (𝟙 W)).symm.hom.app (hom l E W M N) ≫
        c.derived.hom.app (op M, N) ≫
        (podReindexingDerivedHom l E W none).map
          (Prod.mkHom (k.derived.inv.app M).op (k.derived.hom.app N))
